content: Insurance agent Anjali Desai followed up with customer Nandini Rajput regarding the DCoders Health Plus policy application (HP-001234) with a deadline of 15/10/2024, providing the application form. Nandini acknowledged receipt, reviewed the form, and asked for clarification on the required documents and the expected timeline for policy activation.

action_items: Customer to fill out and return the application form by 15/10/2024
Agent to clarify required documents for the application process
Agent to provide expected timeline for policy activation
